Silithid reavers, also called battle tanks, are the main attack troops of the silithid. They are very aggressive. Reavers are morphologically similar to the silithid wasp, except with underdeveloped vestigial wings. The Qiraji battle tank mounts are mount versions of these. There is also the Silithid Mini-Tank pet.

Like all silithid, the queen exists to serve the hive, and is specialized in her role by laying eggs. Sigil of Wisdom drops from all raid boss encounters as personal loot in Mogu'shan Vaults, Heart of Fear, Terrace of the Endless Spring, Throne of Thunder or the eight first bosses in Siege of Orgrimmar. The sigils will drop in all four raid modes: Raid Finder, Flexible (for Siege of Orgrimmar), 10/25-player Normal, and 10/25-player Heroic. The chance for the item to drop is one attempt per eligible boss, per week across all difficulties, and the chance for the item to drop is the same regardless of difficulty mode. corrupting Azeroth.]] Silithus: The Wound, also known as the Wound in the World, is the name given to Silithus after the dark titan plunged his sword into Kalimdor. The wake of destruction now covers the majority of the desert. Zidormi and Rhonormu make it possible to switch between old Silithus and the Wound. The impact of the sword has caused the ground around it to always be hot. Several cultists and insects still remain in the ruins, even after the Fourth War.

Silver Stream Mine is located in the northern part of Loch Modan, east of Algaz Station, and southwest of Stonewrought Dam. Although it traditionally was a bountiful source of silver for the dwarves of Ironforge, long ago it eventually became tapped out. It was then converted into a storage depot by the Miners' League. The mine is also the only known source of the Charged Rift Gems used to make mage robes. It was recently been completely taken over by aggressive Tunnel Rat kobolds who seek the mine's resources for themselves.

Silver Tide Trench is a trench located directly south of the Shimmering Grotto in the Shimmering Expanse. Along the border of the trench rests a gigantic creature known as Nespirah, and a cave known as Silver Tide Hollow. The trench comes to an end towards the east and nearby lies the Ruins of Thelserai Temple. To the west the trench leads into the Abyssal Depths. The Great Sambino and his assistant, Felice, can be found on the western part of the trench. Silver Hand, Ebon Blade is a short story by Raphael Ahad that won the 2010 Blizzard Global Writing Contest and is featured on the Blizzard Writing Contest website. In 2013, Micky Neilson stated that the short story may one day be canonized as In the Shadow of the Sun was. The story has not been officially mentioned since the Global Writing Contest and has never been republished by Blizzard, unlike In the Shadow of the Sun. One of the scenes in the story is alluded to in the in-game dialogue between Darion and Alexandros Mograine in Keeper's Respite, in which Darion says "I once told Tirion that only a silver hand can wield an ebon blade", but Blizzard has made no statement on what this means

The Silkwood is a large wooded area in the Jade Forest that stretches from the southwest of Dawn's Blossom all the way to the Forest Heart. The area is infested with spiders, which produce pristine silk. The road that travels through these woods is known as the Silkwood Road.

The Silken Fields is an ancient imperial silk farm that dates back to some of the earliest dynasties of Pandaria, with each generation exceeding in quality of silk over the last. The fields are found southeast of Halfhill in south-central Valley of the Four Winds. Journeyman Chu, in his attempt to increase silk output, accidentally created a strain of vile monsters. These mutated moths now rebel against their masters.
Silkmaster Tsai is a pandaren tailoring trainer found in the Silken Fields in Valley of the Four Winds.
Silk Fist is a pandaren at Silken Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Silk Farmers are pandaren farmers in the Silken Fields of the Valley of the Four Winds. They [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sericulture raise] the silkworms around the valley for cloth. One large worm, named Silky, sometimes bites them instead of the feed they usually eat.

Silky is a giant :Imperial Silkworm in the Silken Fields of the Valley of the Four Winds. It has apparently grown so much that it sometimes tries to bite its own farmers instead of the feed they provide.
Silkweaver Rui is a jinyu at Pearlfin Village in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Silkwood Stalkers are spiders found in the Silkwood in the Jade Forest. They build webs and silk around trees and are required to be slain to avoid travelers from being endangered.
The Silken Shore is part of the southwestern beach of Jade Forest. Paw'don Village and the Veridian Grove are inland to the east, while various Horde ships and the Krasarang Wilds are to the west.

__NOTOC__ Silkweed is gathered from Silkweed herbalism nodes in Valley of the Four Winds on Pandaria. The nodes require herbalism skill 545 or greater in order to successfully gather. Silkweed can be found near water, in areas such as the Pools of Purity and the Gilded Fan, among others. It can also be found on the Windless Isle of Jade Forest.
Silkfeather Hawks are hawks found in Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Silverlaine's Enchanted Crystal is dropped by Baron Silverlaine in Shadowfang Keep during related quests.
The Silver Pig Coin was available through the original Recruit A Friend program. It was also available through an Amazon Prime Gaming promotion from 25 July to 24 August 2023.
Silken Rope is provided as an objective by Instructor Tong for Empty Nests.
The Silkmasters' Satin Robe is a quest reward from Unyielding Fists: Trial of Stone.
Siltwash Terrapin are sea turtles found in Thousand Needles.

__NOTOC__ Silver Covenant Spellblades are high elves of the Silver Covenant in service of the Kirin Tor Offensive. They first appeared in a camp in Townlong Steppes. They are seen at various places on the Isle of Thunder.

__NOTOC__ Silver Covenant Enforcers are soldiers of the Silver Covenant who fought under Jaina Proudmoore's banner during the Purge of Dalaran. They are led by Sorin Magehand and are found in the Underbelly.

__NOTOC__ The Silver Covenant Spellbow are high elf archers of the Silver Covenant who fought under Jaina Proudmoore's banner during the Purge of Dalaran. They are led by Sorin Magehand and are found in The Underbelly. The Spellbows wield a special high elven model of the Skyfire Hawk-Bow that is unobtainable. They later reappeared on the Isle of Thunder.
The Silkmaster's Drape is a quest reward from Where Silk Comes From.
Siltriss the Sharpener is a level 89 rare saurok found in southern Townlong Steppes. Siltriss is a pandarian champion.
Silkfeather Hawk Eggs are found in southwestern Vale of Eternal Blossoms. They contain Fresh Silkfeather Hawk Eggs.

__NOTOC__ Silver Covenant Guardians are high elves found in and around Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown while some are in Silver Covenant ships, The Silver Blade and The Wavecrest. They were present during Death Rising.
Silver Ore Nugget is looted from Silver Ore deposits, by miners with less than 75 Mining.
The Silverleaf Ancient is summoned as part of The Crystal Blade of Torvath vignette in the Shimmer Moor of .
The Silver-Plated Turkey Shooter is a permanent version of the Turkey Shooter.
Silthide is a massive riverbeast who roams Talador's waters.
Silverlaine Family Sword is the objective of A Fitting Weapon.
Silver Defender is an achievement earned from successfully completing a garrison invasion with a Silver rating or better.
The Silver Gilnean Brooch was intended to be looted from a Treasure Chest in Val'sharah.
The Siltshore Crab can be found on Isle of the Watchers in Azsuna.
__NOTOC__ Silver Mackerel can be fished from the waters of the Broken Isles.
Silkweave Satchel is created with Legion Tailoring (1); taught by Pattern: Silkweave Satchel or Sew Far, Sew Good.
Silkweave Bandages is a repeatable quest used for meeting the requirement of Aiding Our Allies.
__NOTOC__ Silkweave Bracer: Outer Layer is crafted by tailors. The recipe is only available during the quest.
__NOTOC__ Silkweave Bracer Lining is crafted by tailors. The recipe is only available during the quest.

The Silverback tribe are hozen operating in Kun-Lai Summit. The Silverbacks attacked a group of grummles coming down the Burlap Trail and led by Brother Yakshoe. They took Yakshoe and his grummles to Knucklethump Hole. They aid the Broketooth and Ookin hozen in attacking the Burlap Trail, and in turn are massacred by the Alliance and Horde heroes sent by local grummles.
